definitions.official_minimum: Sum task usage.tokens only for tasks with complete phase usage; matches comparison.known_tokens_minimum. Whole task dropped from this sum when one phase is unknown.
definitions.phase_minimum: Sum numeric usage.phases[].tokens over all tasks, including known phases of tasks with incomplete totals.
definitions.native_minimum: Sum input/output of every llm_finished or llm_failed trace event with integer native counts and usage_known != false; each phase folder once. Unknown events remain unknown, never zero.
definitions.feedback_nochange: Round has candidate_hash_before and identical candidate_hash after; no claim about correctness or server nondeterminism.
definitions.candidate_exact_duplicate_actions: Subsequent identical action+canonical JSON arguments within one rollout; status-independent, not semantic/context duplicate.
definitions.reader_overlap: Within each editor and same path+SHA, total requested [offset,end) characters minus interval union coverage. Excludes preloaded packet; counts overlapping evidence reads, not tokens.
definitions.request_estimate: Executor heuristic estimate, not exact tokenizer measurement; exceeding declared context is a risk signal, not proof of server truncation.
definitions.duration: Launcher-to-controller-end is actual wall time. Per-task result.seconds excludes launch preparation/final grading; phase/call durations can overlap in parallel probes and must not be added as wall time.
definitions.comparison: Historical original 24/50 and old Harness2 27/50 are reused full 50 rows, not rerun. New arm 25/50. Original has unknown usage, so no exact Token-cost ratio is available.
